subject: Procurement routing & vendor intake — next steps and PO timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novatech.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T19:15:00Z
Subject: Post-call recap + procurement routing ask

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier. Quick recap of the items we agreed on during the call and the asks to keep momentum: 

- Redwood scope: Hosted inference (production), 3 models initially, SLA option review.
- Decision criteria: latency SLO, cost per 1M tokens, and SOC2 + KMS integration.
- Next internal review: Novatech Security team will validate data flow and confirm the need for Private deployment.

Actions we discussed: 
1) You to share the procurement contact + whether you require a vendor packet (vendor intake form) or a PO-only flow.
2) We will send a short vendor packet and an example SOW + W9 to preload your RFQ/PO process.
3) If a PO is required, please confirm the expected approver and invoice routing (AP email).

Tentative timing we heard on the call: Security review ~2 weeks, procurement/PO processing ~2–4 weeks after approvals. 

Attaching our vendor packet and a filled W9 for your records (attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Packet.pdf, redwood-sow-template.docx).

If procurement prefers, we can also provide a short vendor-demo for your procurement/finance team to accelerate vendor acceptance checks.

Thanks — I’ll follow up in 48 hours if I don’t hear back.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Packet.pdf (13 pages) — vendor intake, insurance, security checklist]
[Attachment: redwood-sow-template.docx (docx)]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novatech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@novatech.com>, procurement@novatech.com
Date: 2026-10-04T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + procurement routing ask

Hi Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Procurement route: please send the vendor packet to procurement@novatech.com. We require our vendor intake form + COI for any new vendor.
- Economic buyer: Jared Lowe (cc) will sign off on budget approvals; legal will need to review a short security addendum if you host any customer data.
- Timeline: Security intake kickoff next Tue (2026-10-12). Procurement intake review typically takes 5–10 business days after we receive a complete packet. PO issuance usually 7–14 days post-approval.

I attached the Novatech vendor intake checklist and preferred invoice format for your team to review offline. Also including Jared so he’s aware of the expected costs and timeline.

Elena

Novatech Systems

Subject: Fwd: vendor intake + quick SOW tweak request

Connor — forwarding Elena's reply. I reviewed their intake checklist; two quick items to prep before we send the full packet: 

- They ask for a named insurance carrier + limits on the COI. Legal has the template; I'll insert the policy numbers.
- Their invoice XLS wants net-30 and a specific AP contact line item (AP Invoice To: ap-invoices@novatech.com).

I can update the SOW to call out the Private deployment option and include the SOC2/KMS notes. Suggest we send: updated SOW, completed vendor packet (with COI placeholder), and a one-page summary of data flow for their Security team. I can assemble these by EOD.

—Camila

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novatech.com>, procurement@novatech.com
Cc: Jared Lowe <jared.lowe@novatech.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T16:40:00Z
Subject: Vendor packet and PO routing — follow-up (attachments and timeline)

Hi Elena / Procurement team / Jared — thanks for the details. We’ve attached the updated materials for Novatech intake: vendor packet (completed with insurance placeholders), updated SOW with Private option and security notes, and a one-page architecture/data-flow diagram. 

Concrete asks from Redwood to help accelerate: 
1) Confirm the procurement mailbox to which we should send the final packet for intake: is procurement@novatech.com the canonical address and should we cc ap-invoices@novatech.com?
2) Please confirm whether Novatech Procurement requires a signed SOW before PO issuance or whether a PO referencing the SOW is sufficient.
3) If a DocuSign is required, please share the DocuSign link template or the contact who will send it.
4) Expected PO approver: Jared — can you confirm that you will be the approver once Security & Legal sign off?

Timelines we’re proposing from Redwood: security review kickoff 2026-10-12 -> procurement intake complete by 2026-10-22 -> PO issuance by 2026-11-05 (slack if procurement moves faster). We will hold current pricing until 2026-11-30.

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Packet.pdf (completed), redwood-sow-updated.pdf, redwood-dataflow-onepager.pdf, Novatech-W9-scan.pdf (signed).

If you prefer, Ben can run a short 20-minute payment and billing walk-through with your AP team to confirm invoice fields.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
